requirements.requirement: curl package on node1 is held at its current installed version (8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8) so a system update leaves it unchanged
requirements.summary: Baseline curl version 8.5.0-2ubuntu10.8 identified (cmd-17ce939b60cf4ed8). apt-mark hold curl applied and confirmed via apt-mark showhold and dpkg --get-selections (cmd-a92d5de182594d9a, cmd-4b7d4f19e3574b81). A simulated apt-get upgrade (apt-get -s upgrade) directly demonstrates curl is excluded from the upgrade set while an unrelated dependent package (libcurl3t64-gnutls) would still be upgraded, confirming the hold is effective and scoped correctly to curl. Post-reboot verification (cmd-c216acdc68744b36) shows curl remains at the same version with hold flag 'hi' and the binary still functions, confirming persistence across a real restart.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node1: pre-restart boot identity/health, restart acknowledgement, differing post-restart boot identity, and recovered service/data/hold state
requirements.summary: Pre-restart baseline captured boot_id bfd05127-56aa-4657-b540-847a25f90491, system-running=running, and curl hold status (cmd-ee3afb32419c43d5), matching the fixed after_prepare boot-identity snapshot. Reboot was triggered and acknowledged asynchronously (cmd-b2825a8610624e32), followed by a connection timeout confirming disconnection during restart (cmd-e41dd638f71e47b7). A new boot_id 16959888-d0bf-4d7d-aae8-16959e7dc21b was observed after reconnection (cmd-cbe2c3ab4f0349cf), matching the fixed after_executor boot-identity snapshot and differing from the pre-restart value, directly proving a real reboot occurred. Post-restart recovery was confirmed with system-running=running, curl hold intact, correct version, and functioning binary (cmd-c216acdc68744b36). No failed services appear in the after_executor global snapshot.

overall_summary: The task's material outcome — holding curl at its current version so system updates skip it — is directly and coherently satisfied: baseline version and absence of prior holds identified, apt-mark hold applied and verified, and a simulated upgrade concretely demonstrates curl is excluded while an unrelated dependent package would still upgrade. The mandatory node-restart evidence protocol is also fully and directly demonstrated with matching pre/post boot identities, an observed disconnection during reboot, and confirmed persistence of the curl hold and functioning curl binary after restart. No unnecessary or unsafe mutations were found in the executor's command trace.
limitations: The simulated apt-get upgrade (apt-get -s) shows curl would be kept back, but no non-simulated apt-get upgrade was run post-reboot to confirm a live upgrade attempt also skips curl in practice, though this is a reasonable and low-risk verification method for a hold.

The before_prepare and after_prepare snapshots are identical (prepare stage was disabled), so no preparer-created state could be distinguished from executor changes, though this did not affect the assessment since no such state existed.

operational_hygiene.summary: Reviewing the executor's terminal commands in order: version/hold discovery (read-only), apt-mark hold curl (directly required by the task, retained as intended state), simulated (-s, non-committing) apt-get upgrade (read-only verification, no state change), pre-restart snapshot (read-only), reboot trigger (required prerequisite for the mandated node-restart evidence protocol), post-reboot polls and verification (read-only). No unnecessary, unbounded, or destructive mutations were found; the only state-changing actions (apt-mark hold and the reboot) each map directly to a material outcome or the mandated restart protocol. The dpkg/temp-file/socket diffs between after_prepare and after_executor snapshots are normal, expected artifacts of the boot-id change from the reboot (new systemd-private temp dirs, re-established listening sockets) and not executor-caused residue or abandoned state. Package health (dpkg) remained 'manager=dpkg' clean in both snapshots, and failed-services stayed empty.
